notify.title: Notifications (Apprise)
notify.explanation: Finished and failed downloads and what the followed searches found are sent through an Apprise API server to the services of the Apprise URLs. What happens close together is one message. Leave it empty to send nothing.
notify.urls_placeholder: Use Apprise URL format, one per line. Examples: discord://WebhookID/Token, slack://TokenA/TokenB/TokenC
notify.urls_saved: {count} Apprise URL(s) saved. Enter new ones to replace them, leave empty to keep them.
notify.censored: Censor the messages: only how many, no titles of comics and no searches
notify.test_sent: Sent, the test message should arrive in a moment.
